subject: Reorg: prorated merit + equity top-up request for Mina Haddad
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reorg: prorated merit + equity top-up request for Mina Haddad

Hi Neha / Lauren —

Quick summary: following the engineering org change we discussed last week, Mina will be transitioning from Senior Staff Engineer (individual contributor) to Engineering Manager, effective 1/4/2027. The promotion is merited given team expansion and the leadership responsibilities she is taking on (hiring, direct reports, cross-functional ownership).

Ask: approval for an exception to the standard cycle to: 
- apply a prorated merit increase (5% of base) effective 1/4/2027 to account for the promotion mid-cycle
- one-time spot bonus of $10,000 (taxable) to recognize transition responsibilities through Q2
- a mid-cycle equity top-up: 600 RSUs (4-year vest) to bring manager-level long-term alignment.

Rationale (short):
- Mina is taking on 3 direct reports + will drive the new infra onboarding workstream (high impact).
- Market comp shows manager-level equity gap for her band; this is restorative and retention-focused.
- We propose funding to come from ENG headcount uplift (budget code ENG-OPS-2026).

I attached a short worksheet with proposed math and band comparisons. If we can get HR + comp committee sign-off this week I can communicate to Mina and align the effective date with the org change.

Attachments: 2026Q4-comp-proposal-mina-haddad.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps I propose:
1) Neha: quick sanity check on policy exceptions and payroll timing
2) Lauren / Vivek: confirmation on manager recommendation and budget sign-off
3) If green, route to Compensation Committee for formal approval (I can own the doc)

Thanks — Apologies for the rush, this is time-sensitive for hiring & org timeline.

--
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations (acting as partner for ENG reorg)
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reorg: prorated merit + equity top-up request for Mina Haddad

Thanks Aditya — good context. A few quick clarifying q's before I can route to Comp Committee: 

1) Band alignment: what band are you proposing Mina should be moved to (people/engineering bands)? Please confirm target salary band and how the 5% sits relative to midpoint.
2) Budget owner: you noted ENG-OPS-2026 — can we get a written confirmation from Finance (or Vivek) that the budget will cover the spot + RSU issuance this FY?
3) Vesting ask: are the 600 RSUs a fresh grant or a refresh replacing an upcoming grant? If replacement, please note replacement details.
4) Payroll timing: to be effective 1/4/2027 the merit needs to be in the Jan payroll cycle; submit no later than 12/22 for processing. Will that timeline work?

I can prepare a one-page exception memo once the inputs above are confirmed. Quick note: Policy allows manager-level adjustments mid-cycle in retention cases, but we have to capture manager sign-off and finance approval.

Please see quoted original below.

On Tue, Dec 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick summary: following the engineering org change we discussed last week, Mina will be transitioning from Senior Staff Engineer ...

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reorg: prorated merit + equity top-up request for Mina Haddad

Thanks — I support this request in principle. A few operational notes: 

- Budget: Confirmed that we have flexibility under ENG-OPS-2026 to cover a one-time spot + RSU refresh; I'll send a short note to Finance to lock the funding path.
- Merit: 5% prorated seems reasonable given the promotion timing. HR should handle the effective date alignment with payroll.
- Equity: Prefer the RSU grant but suggest we cap at 600 RSUs as requested. If Comp Committee prefers an alternative (e.g., 400 RSUs + $5k cash), we can discuss, but my preference is equity to preserve ongoing retention signal.

Lauren / Aditya: please include a line confirming the role level and the expected span (direct reports count) so comp committee has the org-level justification. Neha, once you have the memo I'll expedite to the committee and loop Finance.

FWIW: Mina has consistently delivered on the onboarding/scale work and was on the short list for a manager role in Q3 — this is overdue.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reorg: prorated merit + equity top-up request for Mina Haddad

Neha / Aditya — thanks for moving quickly on this.

Confirmation from my side: 
- Role level: Engineering Manager, Level EM2 (manager band).
- Span: 3 direct reports (two IC hires in progress + one internal transfer).
- Impact: Mina will lead infra onboarding, recruiting for the team, and be the primary stakeholder for cross-team SLAs.

I confirm the proposed numbers: 5% prorated merit, $10k one-time spot bonus, 600 RSU refresh. I also confirm ENG-OPS-2026 as the budget owner and will track spend in my Q4 reforecast.

Attached: signed approval for routing to Compensation Committee. Please expedite payroll timing so we can align the effective date to 1/4/2027.

Attachments: comp-approval-signed-mina-haddad.pdf (signed approval stub)

Mina — congrats! I'll follow up with a short note and alignment on start-of-manager expectations and 1:1 schedule.

--
Lauren Bishop
Group Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
